changes.new: Saturday, Sunday and holidays are not business days.
changes.support: any day other than a Saturday, Sunday, or holiday as defined in section 645.44.

changes.new: Three business days (Saturday does not count), 10 point bold, oral notice; insurance-paid roofing 72 hours after the insurer denies the claim
changes.support: has the right to cancel the contract within 72 hours after the insured has been notified by the insurer that the claim has been denied

changes.new: Home solicitation sales for personal, family or household use over $25, including improvements to real property; an invited in-home sale is covered unless the buyer gives a handwritten, dated, signed waiver
changes.support: Without that handwritten waiver an invited in-home sale is still a home solicitation sale.

changes.new: Writing for licensees: summary, materials, price; written performance guidelines given before signing and included or incorporated by reference; signed and dated; free signed copy (326B.809)
changes.support: Before entering into an agreement, the licensee shall provide a prospective customer with written performance guidelines for the services to be performed. Performance guidelines also must be included or incorporated by reference in the agreement.

unsure: MN-roofing-cancel: added because the statute puts a statement and form in an insurance-paid roofing contract, but the file says it is out of scope for the five trades unless roofing is included.
MN-lien: the statute puts the notice in the contract only when subcontractors or suppliers are used, so even a cut-out copy could not be printed on every residential contract.
MN auto-renewal (325G.57): the offer terms and yearly notice are required but no sentence is prescribed, so no notice was added.
